title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Is Hiding the Dragon? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg has the dragon inside? Choose the purple egg, the golden egg, or the cracked egg and find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Kidify #FunForKids #EggReveal #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: A dragon is hiding inside one of these eggs — but which one?
You've got three choices: the purple egg, the golden egg, or the cracked egg!
Pick your egg right now! The countdown is on — three, two, one!
The purple egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack, not a dragon!
The cracked egg pops open and… it's a tiny little frog! Ribbit! So close!
The golden egg glows, shakes, and BOOM — a baby dragon bursts out! The gold egg wins!
Did you get it right? Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it gets way harder!
